Chapter headingVol. 3, p. 64

Chapter on the abrogating: this is the Book of the Abrogating and the Abrogated.

‌ ‌باب الناسخ: وهذا كتاب الناسخ والمنسوخ

No. 146Vol. 3, p. 64

146. He said: Al-Qasim ibn Abd Allah ibn Umar ibn Hafs ibn Asim ibn Umar ibn al-Khattab informed me, from Zayd ibn Aslam, that he said: God said: "We do not abrogate a verse or cause it to be forgotten except that We bring forth one better than it or similar to it"; and God said: "And when We substitute a verse in place of another," "and God knows best what He sends down"; and said: "God erases what He wills and confirms, and with Him is the Mother of the Book." ⦗p. 65⦘ Zayd said: The first thing abrogated from the Qur'an was the qibla. Muhammad, the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, faced the rock of Jerusalem, which was the qibla of the Jews, for seventeen months, so that they might believe in him, follow him, and help him from among the unlettered Arabs. God said: "To God belong the east and the west, so wherever you turn, there is the face of God; indeed, God is all-encompassing and knowing." Then He said: "We see the turning of your face toward the sky, so We will surely turn you toward a qibla with which you will be pleased. So turn your face toward al-Masjid al-Haram."

146 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الخاطب عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: قَالَ اللَّهُ: {مَا نَنْسَخْ مِنْ آيةٍ أَوْ نُنْسِهَا نأت بخيرٍ منها أو مثلها}؛ وقال الله: {وإذا بدلنا آيةً}، {والله أعلم بما ينزل}، وقال: {يمحوا الله ما يشاء ويثبت وعنده أم الكتاب}؛ ⦗ص: 65⦘ فَقَالَ زَيْدٌ: فَأَوَّلُ مَا نُسِخَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ نُسِخَتِ الْقِبْلَةُ؛ كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتَقْبِلُ صَخْرَةَ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ، وَهِيَ قِبْلَةُ الْيَهُودِ، سَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ شَهْرًا لِيُؤْمِنُوا به، ويتبعونه وينصرونه مِنَ الأُمِّيِّينَ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ؛ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ: {وَلِلَّهِ الْمَشْرِقُ وَالْمَغْرِبُ فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ اللَّهِ إن الله واسعٌ عليمٌ}؛ ثُمَّ قَالَ: {قَدْ نَرَى تَقَلُّبَ وَجْهِكَ فِي السَّمَاءِ فَلَنُوَلِّيَنَّكَ قِبْلَةً تَرْضَاهَا فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ المسجد الحرام}.

No. 147Vol. 3, p. 65

147. Then He said in Ramadan: "And upon those who are able [to fast but with hardship], a ransom: the food of the poor," so whoever wished fasted and whoever wished ransomed by feeding the poor; "and whoever volunteers good, it is better for him; and that you fast is better for you, if you only knew." Then the next verse abrogated it, so He said: "So whoever of you witnesses the month, let him fast it, and whoever is ill or on a journey, then a number of other days." He said: "Fasting has been prescribed for you as it was prescribed for those before you." He said: When they prayed the isha prayer, food, drink, and women became forbidden to them, and they fasted until the same time the next day. One man betrayed himself and had intercourse with his wife after praying isha ⦗p. 66⦘ without having broken his fast, and he was Umar ibn al-Khattab. So God made in that a concession and a blessing and abrogated it, saying: "God knew that you used to deceive yourselves, so He accepted your repentance and forgave you. So now, have relations with them and seek what God has decreed for you, and eat and drink until the white thread becomes distinct to you from the black thread of dawn; then complete the fast until the night."

147 - ثم قال في رمضان: {وعلى الذين يطيقونه فديةٌ طعام} مساكين، فمن شاء صام، ومن شاء افتدى بطعام مساكين، {فمن تطوع خيرا فهو خيرٌ له وأن تصوموا خيرٌ لكم إن كنتم تعلمون}؛ ثم نسختها الآية الأخرى التي تليها، فقال: {فمن شهد منكم الشهر فليصمه ومن كان مريضا أو على سفرٍ فعدةٌ من أيامٍ أخر}؛ قال: {كتب عليكم الصيام كما كتب على الذين من قبلكم}؛ قال: كانوا إذا صلوا العشاء حرم عليهم الطعام والشراب والنساء، وصاموا إلى مثلها من القابلة، فاختان رجلٌ نفسه فجامع امرأته وقد صلى العشاء ⦗ص: 66⦘ ولم يفطر، وهو عمر بن الخطاب، فجعل الله في ذلك رخصة وبركة، فنسخها فقال: {علم الله أنكم كنتم تختانون أنفسكم فتاب عليكم وعفا عنكم فالآن باشروهن وابتغوا ما كتب الله لكم وكلوا واشربوا حتى يتبين لكم الخيط الأبيض من الخيط الأسود من الفجر ثم أتموا الصيام من الليل}.

No. 148Vol. 3, p. 66

148. Then He said: "if he leaves good, a bequest for the parents and relatives"; this was abrogated by the verse of inheritance.

148 - ثم قال: {إن ترك خيرا الوصية للوالدين والأقربين}؛ فنسختها آية الميراث.

No. 149Vol. 3, p. 66

149. He said: "Divorced women shall wait by themselves three monthly periods, and it is not lawful for them to conceal what God has created in their wombs if they believe in God and the Last Day; and their husbands have more right to take them back in that case, if they wish reconciliation." A man who divorced his wife had more right to take her back, even if he had divorced her three times; this was abrogated, and He said: "Divorce is twice, then either retention in kindness or release with good treatment."

149 - قال: {والمطلقات يتربصن بأنفسهن ثلاثة قروءٍ ولا يحل لهن أن يكتمن ما خلق الله في أرحامهن إن كن يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر وبعولتهن أحق بردهن في ذلك إن أرادوا إصلاحاً}، كان الرجل إذا طلق المرأة فهو أحق بردها، وإن كان طلقها ثلاثا؛ فنسخت، فقال: {الطلاق مرتان فإمساك بمعروفٍ أو تسريح بإحسانٍ}.

No. 150Vol. 3, p. 66

150. And God said: "Those who die among you and leave wives behind, a bequest ⦗p. 67⦘ for their wives: provision for a year without expulsion"; then it was abrogated by the verse of inheritance in Sura al-Nisa, when He prescribed for them a quarter or an eighth.

150 - وقال الله: {والذين يتوفون منكم ويذرون أزواجا وصية ⦗ص: 67⦘ لأزواجهم متاعا إلى الحول غير إخراجٍ}؛ ثم نسختها آية الميراث في سورة النساء حين فرض لهن الربع أو الثمن.

No. 151Vol. 3, p. 67

151. And He said: "And do not marry polytheistic women until they believe, and a believing slave woman is better than a polytheist even though she may please you"; this was abrogated and an exception was made: He made lawful, of the polytheistic women, the women of the People of the Book in Sura al-Maida. God said: "This day [all] good things have been made lawful for you, and the food of those who were given the Scripture is lawful for you and your food is lawful for them, and [lawful are] chaste women from among the believers and chaste women from among those who were given the Scripture before you," and He said: "It is not lawful for you to take anything of what you have given them unless both fear that they will not keep within the limits of God," "there is no blame on them for what she gives up to be free."

151 - وقال: {ولا تنكحوا المشركات حتى يؤمن ولأمةٌ مؤمنةٌ خيرٌ من مشركةٍ ولو أعجبتكم}؛ فنسخ واستثنى منها: فأحل من المشركات نساء أهل الكتاب في سورة المائدة؛ قال الله: {اليوم أحل لكم الطيبات وطعام الذين أوتوا الكتاب حلٌ لكم وطعامكم حلٌ لهم والمحصنات من المؤمنات والمحصنات من الذين أوتوا الكتاب من قبلكم}، وقال: {لا يحل لكم أن تأخذوا مما آتيتموهن شيئا إلا أن يخافا ألا يقيما حدود الله}، {فلا جناح عليهما فيما افتدت به}.

No. 152Vol. 3, p. 67

152. And He said: "Divorced women shall wait by themselves three monthly periods," ⦗p. 68⦘ and said: "then their waiting period is three months"; this was abrogated and an exception was made, and He said: "O you who believe, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them, you have no waiting period to count against them; so provide for them and release them with a gracious release." And He said: "God does not burden a soul beyond its capacity; it will have what it has gained, and it will bear what it has earned."

152 - وقال: {والمطلقات يتربصن بأنفسهن ثلاثة قروءٍ}، ⦗ص: 68⦘ وقال: {فعدتهن ثلاثة أشهرٍ}؛ فنسخ واستثنى منها، فقال: {يا أيها الذين آمنوا إذا نكحتم المؤمنات ثم طلقتموهن من قبل أن تمسوهن فما لكم عليهن من عدةٍ تعتدونها فمتعوهن وسرحوهن سراحا جميلا}؛ وقال: {لا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ}.

No. 153Vol. 3, p. 68

153. And God said in al-Maida: "So if they come to you, judge between them or turn away from them"; this was abrogated, and He said: "And judge between them by what God has revealed, and do not follow their inclinations, and beware of them, lest they tempt you away from some of what God has revealed to you."

153 - وقال الله في المائدة: {فَإِنْ جَاءُوكَ فَاحْكُمْ بينهم أو أعرض عنهم}؛ فنسخت، فقال: {وَأَنِ احْكُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ الله ولا تتبع أهواءهم واحذرهم أن يفتونك عن بعض ما أنزل الله إليك}.

No. 154Vol. 3, p. 68

154. And He said in Sura al-Nisa: "And when the relatives, the orphans, and the needy attend the division, provide for them from it"; the verse of inheritance abrogated it: to each person his share. And He said concerning the wealth ⦗p. 69⦘ of orphans: "Whoever is rich, let him abstain, and whoever is poor, let him eat in a proper manner." Then He said to one who eats it unjustly: "Indeed, those who consume the wealth of orphans unjustly are only consuming fire in their bellies, and they will be burned in a Blaze."

154 - وقال في سورة النساء: {وإذا حضر القسمة أولوا القربى واليتامى والمساكين فارزقوهم منه}؛ فنسختها آية الميراث؛ لكل امرئٍ نصيبه؛ وقال في أموال ⦗ص: 69⦘ اليتامى: {من كان غنيا فليستعفف ومن كان فقيرا فليأكل بِالْمَعْرُوفِ}؛ ثم قال لمن أكله ظلما: {إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ أَمْوَالَ الْيَتَامَى ظُلْمًا إِنَّمَا يَأْكُلُونَ في بطونهم ناراً وسيصلون سعيراً}.

No. 155Vol. 3, p. 69

155. And God said: "And those who commit immorality among your women, bring against them four witnesses from among you; and if they testify, confine them in houses until death takes them or God ordains for them a way." He mentioned the man together with his wife and combined them, and said: "And the two among you who commit it, punish them both; but if they repent and correct themselves, leave them alone; indeed, God is ever accepting of repentance and merciful." Sura al-Nur abrogated it, saying: "The fornicator and the fornicatress, flog each one of them with a hundred lashes." So He made the penalty upon them, and it was not abrogated after that.

155 - وقال الله: {وَاللَّاتِي يَأْتِينَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مِنْ نِسَائِكُمْ فَاسْتَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ أَرْبَعَةً مِنْكُمْ فَإِنْ شَهِدُوا فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ فِي الْبُيُوتِ حَتَّى يَتَوَفَّاهُنَّ الْمَوْتُ أَوْ يَجْعَلَ الله لهن سبيلاً}؛ ذكر الرجل مع امرأته فجمعهما فقال: {وَاللَّذَانِ يَأْتِيَانِهَا مِنْكُمْ فَآذُوهُمَا فَإِنْ تَابَا وَأَصْلَحَا فَأَعْرِضُوا عنهما إن الله كان تواباً رحيماً}؛ فنسختها سورة النور فقال: {الزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِي فَاجْلِدُوا كُلَّ واحدٍ منهما مائة جلدةٍ}؛ فجعل عليهما الحد، ثم لم ينسخ.

No. 156Vol. 3, p. 69

156. Then He said in Sura al-Nisa: "It is not lawful for you to inherit women by compulsion, nor to prevent them in order to take away part of what you gave them, unless they commit a clear immorality"; and He said: "And those with whom your oaths have made a bond, give them their share." A man ⦗p. 70⦘ would make an alliance with another, saying: "You inherit from me and I inherit from you"; that was abrogated in Sura al-Anfal: "And those of blood relationship are more entitled to one another in the decree of God. Indeed, God is knowing of all things."

156 - ثم قال في سورة النساء: {لا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَرِثُوا النِّسَاءَ كَرْهًا وَلا تَعْضُلُوهُنَّ لِتَذْهَبُوا بِبَعْضِ مَا آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ إلا أن يأتين بفاحشةٍ مبينةٍ}؛ وقال: {والذين عقدت أيمانكم فآتوهم نصيبهم}؛ كان الرجل ⦗ص: 70⦘ يحالف الرجل يقول: ترثني أرثك؛ فنسخ ذلك في سورة الأنفال: {وأولوا الأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَى ببعضٍ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إن الله بكل شيءٍ عليمٌ}.

No. 157Vol. 3, p. 70

157. And He said in Sura al-Nisa: "O you who believe, do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated until you know what you are saying"; and in Sura al-Baqara: "They ask you about wine and gambling. Say, in them is great sin and [some] benefit for people, but their sin is greater than their benefit." This was abrogated in al-Maida, where He said: "O you who believe, wine, gambling, stone altars, and divining arrows are but defilement from the work of Satan, so avoid it that you may succeed."

157 - وقال في سورة النساء: {يا أيها الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لا تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلاةَ وَأَنْتُمْ سُكَارَى حتى تعلموا ما تقولون}؛ وقال في سورة البقرة {يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْخَمْرِ وَالْمَيْسِرِ قُلْ فِيهِمَا إثمٌ كبيرٌ وَمَنَافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَإِثْمُهُمَا أَكْبَرُ مِنْ نفعهما}؛ فنسخت في المائدة فقال: {يا أيها الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّمَا الْخَمْرُ وَالْمَيْسِرُ وَالأَنْصَابُ وَالأَزْلامُ رجسٌ مِنْ عَمَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ فَاجْتَنِبُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ}.

No. 158Vol. 3, p. 70

158. And He said in Sura al-Nisa: "except for those who take refuge with a people between you ⦗p. 71⦘ and whom there is a treaty, or those who come to you with hearts restrained from fighting you or fighting their own people. And if God had willed, He could have given them power over you, and they would have fought you. So if they withdraw from you and do not fight you and offer you peace, then God has not made for you a cause against them." And He said: "You will find others who wish to obtain security from you and security from their people. Every time they are returned to [the temptation of] disbelief, they fall into it. So if they do not withdraw from you or offer you peace or restrain their hands, then seize them and kill them wherever you overtake them. And those, We have made for you against them a clear authority." And He said in Sura al-Mumtahina: "God does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes, from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them. Indeed, God loves those who act justly." Then He said in it: "God only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion ⦗p. 72⦘ and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion, that you make allies of them. And whoever makes allies of them, then it is those who are the wrongdoers." These verses were abrogated in the matter of the polytheists, and He said: "[This is a declaration of] disassociation, from God and His Messenger, to those with whom you made a treaty among the polytheists: So travel freely in the land for four months, and know that you cannot cause God failure and that God will disgrace the disbelievers." So He gave them a term of four months to travel in, and nullified what had been before that. Then He said in the verse that follows it: "And when the sacred months have passed, then kill the polytheists wherever you find them, and capture them and besiege them and sit in wait for them at every ambush." Then He abrogated and excepted: "But if they repent, establish prayer, and give zakat, let them go on their way; indeed, God is forgiving and merciful." And He said: "And if any one of the polytheists seeks your protection, then grant him protection so that he may hear the words of God; then deliver him to his place of safety."

158 - وقال في سورة النساء: {إِلا الَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ إِلَى قومٍ بَيْنَكُمْ ⦗ص: 71⦘ وَبَيْنَهُمْ ميثاقٌ أَوْ جَاءُوكُمْ حَصِرَتْ صُدُورُهُمْ أَنْ يُقَاتِلُوكُمْ أَوْ يُقَاتِلُوا قَوْمَهُمْ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَسَلَّطَهُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ فَلَقَاتَلُوكُمْ فَإِنِ اعْتَزَلُوكُمْ فَلَمْ يُقَاتِلُوكُمْ وَأَلْقَوْا إِلَيْكُمُ السَّلَمَ فَمَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ عليهم سبيلاً}؛ وقال: سَتَجِدُونَ آخَرِينَ يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يَأْمَنُوكُمْ وَيَأْمَنُوا قَوْمَهُمْ كُلَّ مَا رُدُّوا إِلَى الْفِتْنَةِ أُرْكِسُوا فِيهَا فَإِنْ لَمْ يَعْتَزِلُوكُمْ وَيُلْقُوا إِلَيْكُمُ السَّلَمَ ويكفوا أيديهم فخذوهم واقتلوهم حيث ثقفتموهم وأولائكم جعلنا لكم عليهم سلطاناً مبيناً}؛ وقال في سورة الممتحنة: {لا يَنْهَاكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يُقَاتِلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَلَمْ يُخْرِجُوكُمْ مِنْ دِيَارِكُمْ أَنْ تَبَرُّوهُمْ وَتُقْسِطُوا إِلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ المقسطين}؛ ثم قال فيها: {إِنَّمَا يَنْهَاكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ قَاتَلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ ⦗ص: 72⦘ وَأَخْرَجُوكُمْ مِنْ دِيَارِكُمْ وَظَاهَرُوا عَلَى إِخْرَاجِكُمْ أَنْ تَوَلَّوْهُمْ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّهُمْ فأولائك هم الظالمون}؛ فنسخ هؤلاء الآيات في شأن المشركين، فقال: {براءةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ إِلَى الَّذِينَ عَاهَدْتُمْ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فَسِيحُوا فِي الأَرْضِ أَرْبَعَةَ أشهرٍ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِي اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مخزي الكافرين}؛ فجعل لهم أجلا أربعة أشهر يسيحون فيها وأبطل ما كان قبل ذلك، ثم قال في الآية التي تليها: {فَإِذَا انْسَلَخَ الأَشْهُرُ الحرم فاقتلوا المشركين حيث وجدتموهم واحصروهم واقعدوا لهم كل مرصدٍ}؛ ثم نسخ واستثنى: {فَإِنْ تَابُوا وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَآتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ فَخَلُّوا سَبِيلَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غفورٌ رحيمٌ}؛ وقال: {وَإِنْ أحدٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ اسْتَجَارَكَ فَأَجِرْهُ حَتَّى يَسْمَعَ كَلامَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ أَبْلِغْهُ مَأْمَنَهُ.

No. 159Vol. 3, p. 72

159. And He said in Sura al-Nisa: "Do not consume one another's wealth unjustly, but only [in] trade by mutual consent among you." A man used to feel reluctant to eat at the house of anyone. That was abrogated by the verse in Sura al-Nur: "And there is no blame upon ⦗p. 73⦘ you that you eat from your [own] houses or the houses of your fathers, or the houses of your mothers, or the houses of your brothers, or the houses of your sisters, or the houses of your paternal uncles, or the houses of your paternal aunts, or the houses of your maternal uncles, or the houses of your maternal aunts, or [from houses] whose keys you possess, or [from the house of] a friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately."

159 - وقال في سورة النساء: {لا تَأْكُلُوا أَمْوَالَكُمْ بَيْنَكُمْ بِالْبَاطِلِ إِلا أَنْ تكون تجارةً عن تراضٍ منكم}؛ كان الرجل يتحرج أن يأكل عند أحدٍ من الناس. فنسخ ذلك بالآية التي في سورة النور: {وليس عليكم جناحٌ ⦗ص: 73⦘ أَنْ}، {تَأْكُلُوا مِنْ بُيُوتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ آبَائِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ إِخْوَانِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخَوَاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَعْمَامِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ عَمَّاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخْوَالِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ خَالاتِكُمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكْتُمْ مَفَاتِحَهُ أَوْ صَدِيقِكُمْ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جناحٌ أَنْ تَأْكُلُوا جَمِيعًا أَوْ أَشْتَاتًا}.

No. 160Vol. 3, p. 73

160. And He said in Sura al-Anfal: "If there are among you twenty who are steadfast, they will overcome two hundred; and if there are among you a hundred, they will overcome a thousand of those who disbelieve, because they are a people who do not understand." Then it was abrogated by the verse that follows it, and He said: "Now God has lightened [the burden] for you, and He knows that among you is weakness. So if there are among you a hundred who are steadfast, they will overcome two hundred; and if there are among you a thousand, they will overcome two thousand by permission of God; and God is with the steadfast."

160 - وقال في سورة الأنفال: {إِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَابِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوا مِائَتَيْنِ وَإِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ مائةٌ يَغْلِبُوا أَلْفًا مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِأَنَّهُمْ قومٌ لا يَفْقَهُونَ}؛ ثم نسخت بالآية التي تليها، فقال: {الآنَ خَفَّفَ اللَّهُ عَنْكُمْ وَعَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ ضَعْفًا فَإِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ مائةٌ صابرةٌ يَغْلِبُوا مِائَتَيْنِ وَإِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ ألفٌ يَغْلِبُوا أَلْفَيْنِ بِإِذْنِ الله والله مع الصابرين}.

No. 161Vol. 3, p. 73

161. And He said: "Indeed, those who believed and emigrated and fought with their wealth and lives in the cause of God, and those who gave shelter and aid, they are allies of one another. But those who believed and did not ⦗p. 74⦘ emigrate, you have no responsibility for their protection at all until they emigrate." So the Bedouin did not inherit from the Emigrant. And He said: "And if they incline toward peace, then incline to it"; the verse in Bara'a abrogated it: "Fight those who do not believe in God or in the Last Day and do not consider unlawful what God and His Messenger have made unlawful and do not adopt the religion of truth from those who were given the Scripture, until they give the jizya willingly while they are humbled."

161 - وقال: {والذين آمَنُوا وَهَاجَرُوا وَجَاهَدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ فِي سَبِيلِ الله والذين آووا ونصروا أولائك بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بعضٍ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَمْ ⦗ص: 74⦘ يُهَاجِرُوا مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ وَلايَتِهِمْ مِنْ شيءٍ حَتَّى يهاجروا}؛ فكان الأعرابي لا يرث المهاجري، وقال: {وَإِنْ جنحوا للسلم فأجنح لها}؛ فنسختها الآية التي في براءة: {قَاتِلُوا الَّذِينَ لا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَلا بِالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ وَلا يُحَرِّمُونَ مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَلا يَدِينُونَ دِينَ الْحَقِّ مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ حَتَّى يُعْطُوا الْجِزْيَةَ عَنْ يدٍ وهم صاغرون}.

No. 162Vol. 3, p. 74

162. And He said in al-Anfal: "But God would not punish them while you are among them, and God would not punish them while they seek forgiveness." The verse that follows it abrogated it: "But why should God not punish them while they obstruct [people] from al-Masjid al-Haram and they are not its [rightful] guardians? Its [rightful] guardians are not but the righteous, but most of them do not know. And their prayer at the House was nothing but whistling and clapping. So taste the punishment for what you used to disbelieve." So they were killed at Mecca, and hunger and siege befell them.

162 - وقال في الأنفال: {وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَأَنْتَ فِيهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ}؛ فنسختها الآية التي تليها: {وَمَا لَهُمْ أَلَّا يُعَذِّبَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَمَا كَانُوا أَوْلِيَاءَهُ إِنْ أَوْلِيَاؤُهُ إِلا الْمُتَّقُونَ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لا يَعْلَمُونَ وَمَا كَانَ صَلاتُهُمْ عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ إِلا مُكَاءً وَتَصْدِيَةً فَذُوقُوا الْعَذَابَ بما كنت تكفرون}؛ فقتلوا بمكة وأصابهم الجوع والحصار.

No. 163Vol. 3, p. 74

163. And He said in Bara'a: "If you do not go forth, He will punish you with a painful punishment and will replace ⦗p. 75⦘ you with another people, and you will not harm Him at all." And He said: "It was not for the people of Medina and those around them of the Bedouins to remain behind from the Messenger of God or to prefer themselves over himself. That is because they are not afflicted by thirst or fatigue or hunger in the cause of God, nor do they tread on any ground that enrages the disbelievers, nor do they inflict upon an enemy any infliction," the whole verse. The verse that follows it abrogated it with an exception, and He said: "And it is not for the believers to go forth all together. For there should separate from every division of them a group to obtain understanding in the religion and to warn their people when they return to them, that perhaps they will be cautious."

163 - وقال في براءة: {إِلا تَنْفِرُوا يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا وَيَسْتَبْدِلْ ⦗ص: 75⦘ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلا تَضُرُّوهُ شَيْئًا}؛ وقال: {مَا كَانَ لأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُمْ مِنَ الأَعْرَابِ أَنْ يَتَخَلَّفُوا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ وَلا يَرْغَبُوا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ لا يُصِيبُهُمْ ظَمَأٌ وَلا نصبٌ وَلا مخمصةٌ فِي سبيل الله ولا يطؤون مَوْطِئًا يَغِيظُ الْكُفَّارَ وَلا يَنَالُونَ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ نيلاً}، الآية كلها؛ فنسختها واستثنى بالآية التي تليها، فقال: {وما كان المؤمنون لينفروا كافة فولا نَفَرَ مِنْ كُلِّ فرقةٍ مِنْهُمْ طائفةٌ لِيَتَفَقَّهُوا فِي الدِّينِ وَلِيُنْذِرُوا قَوْمَهُمْ إِذَا رَجَعُوا إِلَيْهِمْ لعلهم يحذرون}.

No. 164Vol. 3, p. 75

164. And He said: "Those who believe in God and the Last Day do not ask your permission to be excused from striving with their wealth and their lives, and God is knowing of the righteous. Only those ask your permission who do not believe in God and the Last Day and whose hearts have doubted, and they, in their doubt, are hesitating." The verse in al-Nur abrogated it: "So when they ask your permission for some affair of theirs, then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them from God; indeed, God is forgiving and merciful."

164 - وقال: {لا يَسْتَأْذِنُكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ أَنْ يُجَاهِدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ وَاللَّهُ عليمٌ بِالْمُتَّقِينَ إِنَّمَا يَسْتَأْذِنُكَ الَّذِينَ لا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ وَارْتَابَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِي رَيْبِهِمْ يترددون}؛ فنسختها الآية التي في النور: {فَإِذَا اسْتَأْذَنُوكَ لِبَعْضِ شَأْنِهِمْ فَأْذَنْ لِمَنْ شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ اللَّهَ إِنَّ الله غفورٌ رحيمٌ}.

No. 165Vol. 3, p. 75

165. And He said in Bara'a: "The Bedouins are stronger in disbelief and hypocrisy and more likely not to know the limits ⦗p. 76⦘ of what God has revealed to His Messenger; and God is knowing and wise." And He made an exception from it, saying: "And among the Bedouins are some who believe in God and the Last Day and consider what they spend as means of nearness to God and of the supplications of the Messenger. Unquestionably, it is a means of nearness for them; God will admit them into His mercy."

165 - وقال في براءة: {الأَعْرَابُ أَشَدُّ كُفْرًا وَنِفَاقًا وَأَجْدَرُ أَلَّا ⦗ص: 76⦘ يَعْلَمُوا حُدُودَ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ على رسوله والله عليمٌ حكيم}؛ واستثنى منها فقال: {وَمِنَ الأَعْرَابِ مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ وَيَتَّخِذُ مَا يُنْفِقُ قرباتٍ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَصَلَوَاتِ الرَّسُولِ أَلا إِنَّهَا قربةٌ لهم سيدخلهم الله في رحمته}.

No. 166Vol. 3, p. 76

166. And He said in Sura al-Nahl: "Whoever disbelieves in God after his belief, except for one who is compelled while his heart is secure in faith, but those who open their breasts to disbelief, upon them is wrath from God, and for them is a great punishment." This was abrogated and an exception was made: "Then indeed your Lord, to those who emigrated after they had been persecuted and then fought and were patient, indeed your Lord, after that, is forgiving and merciful." This is Abd Allah ibn Sad ibn Abi Sarh, who was later in charge of Egypt. He used to write for the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, but Satan made him slip and he joined the disbelievers. The Prophet, peace be upon him, ordered him to be killed on the day of the conquest, but Uthman ibn Affan sought protection for him, and the Prophet, peace be upon him, protected him.

166 - وقال في سورة النحل: {من كفر بالله بَعْدِ إِيمَانِهِ إِلا مَنْ أُكْرِهَ وَقَلْبُهُ مطمئنٌ بِالإِيمَانِ وَلَكِنْ مَنْ شَرَحَ بِالْكُفْرِ صَدْرًا فَعَلَيْهِمْ غضبٌ من الله ولهم عذابٌ عظيمٌ}؛ فنسخ واستثنى فقال: {ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هاجرو، مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا فُتِنُوا ثُمَّ جَاهَدُوا وَصَبَرُوا إن ربك من بعدها لغفورٌ رحيمٌ}؛ هو عبد الله بن سعد بن أبي سرح الذي كان على مصر، كان يكتب لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فأزله الشيطان فلحق بالكفار؛ فأمر به النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يقتل اليوم الفتح، فاستجار له عثمان بن عفان، فأجاره النبي عليه السلام.

No. 167Vol. 3, p. 76

167. And He said in Sura Bani Israil: "My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up ⦗p. 77⦘ [when I was] small." Then the verse in Bara'a abrogated part of it: "It is not for the Prophet and those who believe to ask forgiveness for the polytheists, even if they were relatives, after it has become clear to them that they are companions of the Hellfire."

167 - وقال في سورة بني إسرائيل: {رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي ⦗ص: 77⦘ صَغِيرًا}؛ ثم نسخ منها الآية التي في براءة: {مَا كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُوا لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَلَوْ كَانُوا أُولِي قُرْبَى مِنْ بَعْدِ ما تبين لهم أنهم أصحاب الجحيم}.

No. 168Vol. 3, p. 77

168. And He said in Sura Bani Israil: "And do not recite your prayer aloud, nor silently, but seek between that a way." When the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, recited his prayer aloud, it hurt the polytheists in Mecca, so he and his companions hid their prayer. For that reason God said: "And do not recite your prayer aloud, nor silently, but seek between that a way." And He said in Sura al-Araf: "And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and fear, and without loudness of speech, in the morning and evening, and do not be among the heedless."

168 - وقال في سورة بني إسرائيل: {وَلا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاتِكَ وَلا تُخَافِتْ بها وابتغ بين ذلك سبيلاً}؛ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا جهر بصلاته آذى ذلك المشركين بمكة، أخفى صلاته هو وأصحابه؛ فلذلك قال الله: {وَلا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاتِكَ وَلا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَابْتَغِ بين ذلك سبيلاً}؛ وقال في سورة الأعراف: {وَاذْكُرْ رَبَّكَ فِي نَفْسِكَ تَضَرُّعًا وَخِيفَةً وَدُونَ الْجَهْرِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالآصَالِ وَلا تكن من الغافلين}.

No. 169Vol. 3, p. 77

169. And He said in Sura al-Anbiya: "Indeed, you and what you worship besides God are fuel for Hell; you will come to it. If these had been gods, they would not have come to it, and all will abide therein ⦗p. 78⦘ for them therein is sighing, and they will not hear therein." Then He made an exception in the verse that follows it, saying: "Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us, they will be kept far from it."

169 - وقال في سورة الأنبياء: {إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنْتُمْ لَهَا وَارِدُونَ لَوْ كَانَ هَؤُلاءِ آلِهَةً مَا وَرَدُوهَا وكلٌ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ ⦗ص: 78⦘ لَهُمْ فِيهَا زفيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لا يَسْمَعُونَ}؛ ثم استثنى بالآية التي تليها فقال: {إِنَّ الذين سبقت لهم منا الحسنى أولائك عنها مبعدون}.

No. 170Vol. 3, p. 78

170. And He said in al-Nur: "And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses, flog them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after; and those are the defiantly disobedient." And He said right after it: "And those who accuse their wives and have no witnesses except themselves, then the witness of one of them is four testimonies by God that he is among the truthful, and the fifth that the curse of God be upon him if he should be among the liars. But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies by God that he is among the liars, and the fifth that the wrath of God be upon her if he was of the truthful." He said: When they have both sworn, they are separated and neither is flogged; if she does not swear she is stoned; and if her husband does not swear after accusing her, he is given the penalty of flogging.

170 - وقال في النور: {وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَانِينَ جلدةً ولا تقبلوا لهم شهادةً أبداً وأولائك هم الفاسقون}؛ وقال في أثرها: {وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ شُهَدَاءُ إِلا أَنْفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَادَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شهاداتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ وَالْخَامِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَةَ اللَّهِ عليه إن كان من الكاذبين ويدرؤا عَنْهَا الْعَذَابَ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شهاداتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ وَالْخَامِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ اللَّهِ عليها إن كانت من الصادقين} قال: فإذا حلفا فرق بينهما ولم يجلد واحد منهما، وإن لم تحلف رجمت، وإن لم يحلف زوجها بعد أن يقذفها جلد الحد.

No. 171Vol. 3, p. 78

171. And He said in Sura al-Nur: "And tell the believing women to lower ⦗p. 79⦘ their gaze and guard their private parts and not display their adornment except what is apparent of it," until He reached: "and not display their adornment except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, those their right hands possess, or those male attendants having no physical desire, or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women." This was abrogated by: "And women of post-menstrual age who have no desire for marriage, there is no blame on them for putting aside their outer garments, as long as they do not display adornment; but to abstain is better for them; and God is hearing and knowing."

171 - وقال في سورة النور: {وَقُلْ لِلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ ⦗ص: 79⦘ أَبْصَارِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلا مَا ظَهَرَ منها}، حتى بلغ: {وَلا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ آبَائِهِنَّ أَوْ آبَاءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَائِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَاءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ إِخْوَانِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِي إِخْوَانِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِي أَخَوَاتِهِنَّ أَوْ نِسَائِهِنَّ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُنَّ أَوِ التَّابِعِينَ غَيْرِ أُولِي الإِرْبَةِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ أَوِ الطِّفْلِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يظهروا على عورات النساء}؛ فنسخ: {وَالْقَوَاعِدُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ اللَّاتِي لا يَرْجُونَ نِكَاحًا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِنَّ جناحٌ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ متبرجاتٍ بزينةٍ وَأَنْ يَسْتَعْفِفْنَ خيرٌ لَهُنَّ والله سميعٌ عليمٌ}.

No. 172Vol. 3, p. 79

172. And He said: "O you who believe, do not enter houses other than your own until you ask permission and greet their inhabitants. That is better for you; perhaps you will be reminded." Then it was abrogated and an exception made: "There is no blame upon you for entering uninhabited houses in which there is convenience for you; and God knows what you reveal and what you conceal." They claim that it refers to the guest.

172 - وقال: {يا أيها الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لا تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ بُيُوتِكُمْ حَتَّى تَسْتَأْنِسُوا وَتُسَلِّمُوا عَلَى أَهْلِهَا ذَلِكُمْ خيرٌ لكم لعلكم تذكرون}؛ ثم نسخ واستثنى منها، فقال: {لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جناحٌ أَنْ تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ مسكونةٍ فِيهَا متاعٌ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تكتمون}؛ يزعمون أنه الضيف.

No. 173Vol. 3, p. 79

173. And He said: "There is no blame upon you that you eat from your [own] houses or ⦗p. 80⦘ the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers." A rich man would invite a man of his family to food over which God's name had been mentioned, and He made lawful the food of the People of the Book.

173 - وقال: {ليس عليكم جناحٌ} أَنْ تَأْكُلُوا مِنْ بُيُوتِكُمْ أَوْ ⦗ص: 80⦘ بُيُوتِ آبَائِكُمْ أو بيوت أمهاتكم}؛ كان الرجل الغني يدعو الرجل من أهله إلى الطعام مما ذكر اسم الله عليه وأحل طعام أهل الكتاب.

No. 174Vol. 3, p. 80

174. And He said in Ta Sin Mim: "And the poets, the deviant follow them. Do you not see that in every valley they roam, and that they say what they do not do?" Then He made an exception, saying: "Except those who believe and do righteous deeds and remember God often and defend themselves after being wronged. And those who have wronged will know to what return they will be returned."

174 - وقال في طسم: {وَالشُّعَرَاءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الْغَاوُونَ أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي كُلِّ وادٍ يَهِيمُونَ وَأَنَّهُمْ يقولون ما لا يفعلون}؛ ثم استثنى فقال: {إِلا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَانْتَصَرُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا وَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا أَيَّ منقلبٍ ينقلبون}.

No. 175Vol. 3, p. 80

175. And He said in Ha Mim al-Ahqaf: "And I do not know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow what is revealed to me, and I am only a clear warner." ⦗p. 81⦘ The verse in Sura al-Fath abrogated it, and He said: "Indeed, We have given you a clear conquest, that God may forgive you what preceded of your sin and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path." The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, came out when this verse was revealed to him and gave them the good news that God had forgiven him his sin, what had preceded and what would follow. A man of the people said to him: "O Messenger of God, we know what God will do with you; what will He do with us, O Messenger of God?" So God revealed in Sura al-Ahzab: "And give good tidings to the believers that they will have from God great bounty"; and revealed: "That He may admit the believing men and believing women to gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein eternally, and remove from them their misdeeds; and that is, in the sight of God, a great attainment; and that He may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women and the polytheist men and polytheist women," "and God will accept repentance from the believing men and believing women; and God is ever forgiving and merciful." So He made clear to them what would be done with him and with them.

175 - وقال في حم الأحقاف: {وَمَا أَدْرِي مَا يُفْعَلُ بِي وَلا بِكُمْ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلا مَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا إِلا نذيرٌ مبينٌ}؛ ⦗ص: 81⦘ فنسختها الآية التي في سورة الفتح فقال: {إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا ليغفر لك الله ما تقدم من ذنبك وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطًا مستقيماً}؛ فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حين أنزلت عليه هذه الآية فبشرهم بأن الله قد غفر له ذنبه ما تقدم منه وما تأخر؛ فقال له رجلٌ من القوم: يا رسول الله، قد علمنا ما يفعل الله بك، فما يفعل بنا، يا رسول الله؛ فأنزل الله في سورة الأحزاب: {وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ فضلاً كبيراً}؛ وأنزل {لِيُدْخِلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ جناتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا وَيُعَذِّبَ المنافقين والمنافقات والمشركين والمشركات}، {وَيَتُوبَ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غفوراً رحيماً}؛ فبين لهم ما يفعل به وبهم.

No. 176Vol. 3, p. 81

176. And He said in the Sura of Private Counsel [al-Mujadila]: "When you privately consult the Messenger, present before your consultation a charity. That is better for you and purer; but if you do not find [the means], then indeed God is forgiving and merciful." The verse that follows it abrogated it, and He said: "Are you afraid to present before your consultation charities? Then when you do not do so and God has forgiven you, then establish prayer and give zakat and obey God and His Messenger; and God is aware of what you do."

176 - وقال في سورة النجوى: {إِذَا نَاجَيْتُمُ الرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَةً ذَلِكَ خيرٌ لَكُمْ وَأَطْهَرُ فَإِنْ لم تجدوا فإن الله غفورٌ رحيمٌ}؛ فنسختها الآية التي تليها، فقال: {ءَأَشْفَقْتُمْ أَنْ تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صدقاتٍ فَإِذْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوا وَتَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَاللَّهُ خبيرٌ بِمَا تعملون}.

No. 177Vol. 3, p. 82

177. And He said in Sura al-Muzzammil: "Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little: half of it, or subtract from it a little, or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation. Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word. Indeed, the rising by night is more effective for concurrence and more suitable for words." The verse that follows it abrogated it: "He knows that you cannot [keep up] with it, so He has turned to you in forgiveness; so recite what is easy of the Qur'an. He knows that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling through the land seeking the bounty of God and others fighting in the cause of God. So recite what is easy of it and establish prayer and give zakat and lend God a good loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves, you will find it with God, better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of God; indeed, God is forgiving and merciful."

177 - وقال في سورة المزمل: {قُمِ اللَّيْلَ إِلا قَلِيلا نِصْفَهُ أَوِ انْقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلا أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ القرآن تَرْتِيلا إِنَّا سَنُلْقِي عَلَيْكَ قَوْلا ثَقِيلا إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ اللَّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطْأً وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلا}؛ فنسختها الآية التي تليها {علم ألن تحصوه فتاب الله عليكم فاقرؤوا ما تيسر من القرآن عَلِمَ أَنْ سَيَكُونُ مِنْكُمْ مَرْضَى وَآخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِي الأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَآخَرُونَ يقاتلون في سبيل الله فاقرؤوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا لأَنْفُسِكُمْ مِنْ خيرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غفورٌ رحيمٌ}.

No. 178Vol. 3, p. 82

178. "And the rising of the night [nashiat al-layl]": Their prayer was at the beginning of the night; He says it is more fitting that you keep up what God made obligatory upon you of standing in prayer at the end of the night, out of concern that sleep would overcome them and they would not seek forgiveness.

178 - {وناشئة الليل}، كانت صلاتهم أول الليل يقول هو أجدر أن تحصوا ما فرض الله عليكم من القيام من آخر الليل شفقة من أن يغلبهم النوم فلا يستغفرون.

No. 179Vol. 3, p. 82

179. He said: And His words "more suitable for words [aqwam qilan]": He says, more fitting that you gain understanding of the Qur'an; and He says: "Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation [sabhan tawilan]": He says, long leisure.

179 - قال: وقوله: {أقوم قيلاً}، يقول: أجدر أن تفقه في القرآن، ويقول: {إن لك في النهار سبحاً طويلاً}، يقول: فراغاً طويلاً.

No. 180Vol. 3, p. 83

180. He said: And He says in al-Dhariyat: "So turn away from them, for you are not to be blamed": He commanded him to turn away from them so that He would punish them, and excused Muhammad the Prophet. Then He said: "And remind, for indeed the reminder benefits the believers."

180 - قال: ويقول في الذاريات: {فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَا أنت بملومٍ}، أمره أن يتولى عنهم ليعذبهم وعذر محمدا النبي، ثم قال: {وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ الذِّكْرَى تَنْفَعُ المؤمنين}.

No. 181Vol. 3, p. 83

181. And He said in al-Maida: "Indeed, the penalty for those who wage war against God and His Messenger and strive upon earth [to cause] corruption is none but that they be killed or crucified or that their hands and feet be cut off from opposite sides or that they be exiled from the land. That is for them a disgrace in this world, and for them in the Hereafter is a great punishment." He said: "Except for those who return [repenting] before you apprehend them. And know that God is forgiving and merciful." So whoever repents before he is overpowered, there is no way against him; but this verse does not protect a Muslim man who has killed, spread corruption, and waged war, from having the penalty carried out on him, should he join the People of the Book.

181 - وقال في المائدة: {إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ الَّذِينَ يُحَارِبُونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِي الأَرْضِ فَسَادًا أَنْ يُقَتَّلُوا أَوْ يُصَلَّبُوا أَوْ تُقَطَّعَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُمْ مِنْ خلافٍ أَوْ يُنْفَوْا مِنَ الأَرْضِ ذَلِكَ لَهُمْ خزيٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَلَهُمْ فِي الآخرة عذابٌ عظيمٌ}؛ قال: {إِلا الَّذِينَ تَابُوا مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَقْدِرُوا عَلَيْهِمْ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ غفورٌ رحيمٌ}؛ فمن تاب من قبل أن يقدر عليه فلا سبيل عليه، وليست تحرز هذه الآية الرجل المسلم إذا قتل أو أفسد وحارب من أن يقام عليه الحد فإن لحق بأهل الكتاب.
